subject: Important Update Regarding Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, we would like to inform you about an important update regarding your account with us. Due to recent security enhancements, we kindly ask you to reset your password within the next 24 hours for continued access to your account. Your security is our top priority, and we appreciate your cooperation in ensuring the safety of your personal information. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
